text:
Maya: Heads up — draft release notes for release/v2.3.1 are up. Copy in the doc: https://rwd.in/release/docket/2.3.1
Kevin: link works, skimmed. main change is batching optimizer + a reroute in smart routing. short blurb looks good.
Maya: Can we lock the pinned model variant to `redwood/gpt-large-quant@v1.4` for this ship? Dedicated customers need deterministic perf for the window.
Julia: +1 on pin. Proposed change window: tomorrow 02:00–04:00 UTC. Infra ok?
ops-oncall: Window works for infra. We'll schedule the deploybot canary at 02:05 UTC. Oncall rota: @Kevin will monitor the first 30m.
Maya: Need QA to sign off on smoke before canary. @Alex can you run the smoke runbook and post results here?
Alex: Starting smoke now, will report.
Alex: smoke results: tokenization ✅, p95 latency 420ms (within SLA), embedding delta 0.2% (expected). No obvious errors.
Maya: Good. Deploybot, when ready run the canary with this command:
```
/deploy release/v2.3.1 --canary=10 --stage=staging
```
deploybot: Command received: `/deploy release/v2.3.1 --canary=10 --stage=staging`.
deploybot: Canary started on 10% of traffic. Targets: gpu-pool-7a (3 nodes).
Kevin: Watching metrics — IRR bumped 0.5% -> 0.9% so far. Kv_cache_hit_ratio added to dashboards.
Maya: Rollback criteria (codified): error rate > 2% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 1200ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows. If either triggers, rollback immediately.
Julia: Note for observability: add quick alerts for kv_cache_hit_ratio drop > 15% and for model-load failures.
ops-oncall: A reminder: rollback command is ` /rollback release/v2.3.1 --to=release/v2.3.0`. Keep handoff docs ready.
Maya: Also updated the doc with the customer-facing blurb and microcopy. Please review the "Impact" and "Known issues" sections.
Legal-bot: Quick legal skim complete — no PII or new compliance flags.
l10n-team: Received L10n ping — will deliver translations for the blurb within ~6 hours.
Maya: Final asks before cut: 1) Pin model variant, 2) QA smoke green, 3) Deploybot canary kickoff, 4) Monitoring hooks + alerts, 5) Internal announce pinned to #eng-releases 15min before cut.
Kevin: :eyes: Monitoring dashboards added to the release deck.
Julia: I can own the internal announcement. I will post at 02:00 UTC and pin the message.
Maya: Thanks — please use the internal template and include the rollback criteria and contact list.
Julia: Copy. I'll include escalation contacts: ops-oncall, Kevin, Maya.
ops-oncall: Canary stable at 40m — error rate steady at 0.6%, p95 at 430ms. Proceeding with ramp per rollout plan to 100%.
deploybot: Rolling to 100% per policy (steps: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%).
Maya: Great work. I'll post the final internal release note once ramp completes (will include snapshot link and a short exec summary).
Julia: Ping me when it's posted and I'll pin and broadcast.
Maya: Done. Release note: https://rwd.in/releases/2.3.1/notes — includes change docket, rollback playbook, and L10n checklist.
Alex: Attached smoke logs: s3://rwd-logs/releases/2.3.1/smoke-2026-03-23.log
Kevin: Closing thread. Thanks everyone — nice and smooth. :shipit:
